text:
ada: Quick sync — we need to pick a single phrasing for our public docs: 'model version' vs 'model revision' vs 'model rev'. Seeing inconsistencies in SDK snippets and CLI help. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: prefer 'model version' — clearest for customers. 'revision' feels internal and ambiguous.

jess: +1. Also: use lowercase 'model version' in body copy, Title Case for headings (e.g., 'Model versions').

ada: Good. For code examples, should we standardize param names to `model_version` or keep `model_ver`?

mike: use `model_version` everywhere in SDKs and examples — explicit is better. Keep snake_case.

jess: Logging/telemetry still uses `model_rev` historically; i'll add a mapping layer but docs should show `model_version`.

ada: I'll update the style guide page at `docs/style/lingual-anchors.md` with the decision and add short Python/TS snippets. Who'll own the snippet updates?

mike: i'll take TS snippets, assigning to me @ada :+1:

jess: i'll handle Python.

docs-bot: PR created -> #4512 by jess: docs: canonicalize 'model version' across python snippets (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4512) :rocket:

ada: Nice. After PRs merge, let's run a search across docs/ for remaining variants and add a CI lint to catch 'model revision' and 'model rev'.

mike: i'll draft a regex for CI: `\b(model\s*(revision|rev)?)\b` — should catch most variants. Will prototype a Danger step.

jess: i'll add unit tests for sample snippets (ensure `model_version` used) and check plural forms too.

ada: Timeline: aim to close this by EOD Friday. If anyone hits blockers, flag here.

mike: Ack — CI PR today.

jess: will merge #4512 once tests pass.

ada: thanks all — linking product for visibility: @product-ux (zoe) — if you want any alternate phrasing, speak up before EOD Fri.
